name: Electrical Gear QA/QC - Main Distribution Walk

items.prompt: Verify the main breaker nameplate against the submittal

voice.look: Look at the white label on the upper door of the main breaker
voice.frame: Stand about an arm's length away and center the label
voice.hint: Tilt slightly if the light is glaring off the plate

items.prompt: Verify the distribution panelboard nameplate, including the AIC rating

voice.look: Look at the nameplate inside the panelboard door, near the top
voice.frame: Open the door, step back an arm's length, and center the plate
voice.safety: Keep the door open with one hand and stay clear of live parts

items.prompt: Verify the dry-type transformer ID placard

voice.look: Look at the large equipment placard on the front of the transformer
voice.frame: Stand a few steps back and center the whole placard
